# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop over multiple increments |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes a single TDD cycle (RED, GREEN with retries, REFACTOR) and optional learning |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment to write via LLM query |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python – delegates code generation and container execution |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD cycles via vitest |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code (test, implementation, refactor) from PodSpec and playbook context |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer – sends files to container and verifies hash integrity |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| ContainerRunner | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Abstract interface for container execution (send_pulse, start, stop) |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Higher-level agent that builds a full feature incrementally using ensemble learning |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, token budgets, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation and bullet retrieval |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes, extracts error patterns and learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook delta bullets |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.) |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic bullet search |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant bullets by semantic similarity and keyword |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects historical TDD lessons into agent prompts per development phase |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality (structure, naming, assertions, edge cases) |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec objects |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent.py | Reverse-engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Security filter that blocks forbidden imports and built-in calls in generated code |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST-signature context maps for providing implementation context to the LLM |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multiple models in parallel to produce and vote on playbook bullets |
| VotingSystem | src/ensemble/voting.py | Applies various voting strategies (majority, supermajority, weighted) to ensemble bullet approvals |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to the best-performing agent based on historical metrics |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates agent performance metrics from audit trail and computes Bayesian estimates |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit store with hash chain integrity for event logging |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service that provides guidance for TDD and implementation |
| CostQualityAnalyzer | src/analytics/cost_quality_analyzer.py | Analyzes cost-quality trade-offs and ranks models by efficiency |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Aggregates token usage data from LanguagePods and computes cross-language efficiency scores |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PDR as PodmanRunner
    participant Ctr as Container
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Cura as Curator
    participant PM as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    Note over Runner,Logger: Iterative TDD Loop (max_iterations)
    loop per increment
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Orch: pulse(files)
        activate Orch
        Orch->>PDR: send_pulse(files)
        PDR->>Ctr: execute test
        Ctr-->>PDR: output
        PDR-->>Orch: result
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orch
        alt red passed (unexpected)
            Pod-->>Cycle: abort (RED passed)
        else red failed (expected)
            Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        end
        deactivate Pod

        Note over Cycle: GREEN phase with retries
        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>Orch: pulse(files)
            activate Orch
            Orch->>PDR: send_pulse(files)
            PDR->>Ctr: execute test
            Ctr-->>PDR: output
            PDR-->>Orch: result
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orch
            alt passed
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                break
            else failed and not abort
                Pod-->>Cycle: error_feedback
                Cycle-->>Pod: retry with updated error_output
            else abort (security/policy)
                Pod-->>Cycle: abort
                break
            end
            deactivate Pod
        end

        alt green passed
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Orch: pulse(files)
            Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod

            Note over Cycle: Learning loop if reflector+curator
            Cycle->>Reflect: reflect(task, output, feedback)
            activate Reflect
            Reflect-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflect
            Cycle->>Cura: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Cura
            Cura-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
            deactivate Cura
            Cycle->>PM: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            activate PM
            PM-->>Cycle: added_bullets
            deactivate PM
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle
    end
    Note over Runner: continue until planner says COMPLETE or iterations exhausted
```
